title: Choose the Missions composition
question: Three structures for the Missions surface (Hologram Workshop world stays fixed). Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Command lattice
options.thesis: Orgs are nodes on an ops lattice; select one to open a side brief of deep-linkable project chips into a media case.
options.viewport: Map as a quiet node lattice of Black Sheep / Freelance / Academia; selecting Academia opens a side brief with Aerial Depot and peers as chips; chip opens /missions/academia/aerial-depot/ with media hero.
options.risk: Density can hurt mobile scan if nodes compete with the project list.

raised.raise: Org and project status use deliberate lit/unlit cells — progress is a fixed mask of segments, not a vague meter wash.

options.label: Timeline ops log
options.thesis: Experience reads as a chronological ops log: orgs as period markers, projects as entries you open for proof.
options.viewport: A vertical time ribbon (2021–Presente) with org stamps; selecting a stamp lists projects as log rows with thumb + link affordance into the case view.
options.risk: Chronology may bury the strongest current work (Black Sheep) below older academia entries unless featured rows pin to top.

options.label: Theater of proof
options.thesis: Three org pillars on the map each peek a featured project plate; drill-in opens a media-hero project stage.
options.viewport: Map shows three pillars with one featured media peek each (e.g. Skool, Leamsi, Aerial); open org → project list; open project → large media stage + live/repo.
options.risk: Featured peeks need real media; mockup projects must not invent screenshots.
